name: model-router
description: Picks the model of each subagent. At agent.spawn Haiku reads the task and answers with a tier and a confidence; the model moves only when the confidence clears the bar for that direction (low to spend more, high to spend less). A model the caller named is never changed. Understands Bedrock inference profile ARNs through the ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL variables. /model-router shows the last picks.

enabled.title: Route subagent models
enabled.description: Pick the model of each subagent at agent.spawn. Off leaves every spawn as it is

fastModel.title: Fast tier
fastModel.description: Model alias or id for mechanical, local tasks. An alias is resolved by Claude Code (on Bedrock, to the ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL profile)

balancedModel.title: Balanced tier
balancedModel.description: Model alias or id for ordinary engineering work

deepModel.title: Deep tier
deepModel.description: Model alias or id for hard or high-stakes work

minUpgradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend more
minUpgradeConfidence.description: How sure Haiku must be to move a subagent to a bigger model. A wrong upgrade only costs money, so the bar is low

minDowngradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend less
minDowngradeConfidence.description: How sure Haiku must be to move a subagent to a smaller model. Also the bar for any move from a model whose tier is unknown. A missing confidence never moves anything

timeoutMs.title: Judge time limit (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Haiku's answer before the spawn goes through unchanged
